    • getNormalizedMarginDerivative

      public double getNormalizedMarginDerivative()
      Gets the normalized margin derivative.

      Call isUsable() before consuming this value. A rejected derivative is retained for auditability but is not qualified for an operating-action calculation.

      Returns:
      derivative of normalized margin with respect to the parameter
